Additional European languages are advantageous. Lead a Region. Transform a Business. Advance Women's Health. At Hologic, we're passionate about improving lives through innovative healthcare solutions. As a global leader in women's health, our Breast & Skeletal Health portfolio is helping clinicians detect disease earlier, improve outcomes, and deliver better care to millions of women worldwide. We're looking for an inspiring and commercially astute General Manager to lead our Breast & Skeletal Health business across DACH, Benelux and the Nordic region. This is one of the most significant leadership opportunities within our international organisation. Spanning direct and distributor-led markets across Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Iceland, you'll shape the future direction of the business while driving sustainable growth across the region. We're seeking a leader who thrives in complex environments, brings a passion for transformation, and knows how to unlock the full potential of people, customers and markets. What To Expect Shape the Regional Strategy Define and execute a clear vision aligned with regional and global business objectives. Develop short, medium and long-term growth plans that drive revenue, profitability and market share. Identify new market opportunities and create strategies to maximise commercial performance. Drive Commercial Excellence Lead commercial execution across direct and distributor-led markets. Improve sales effectiveness through robust forecasting, performance management and data-driven decision making. Influence pricing strategies, contract negotiations, tenders and key commercial partnerships. Ensure strong operational discipline and consistent execution across the region. Lead Transformation Drive business transformation initiatives that strengthen organisational effectiveness and customer engagement. Identify and remove barriers to growth while embedding a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Lead teams confidently through periods of change, building alignment and commitment across diverse stakeholder groups. Build High-Performing Teams Inspire, develop and retain exceptional talent across multiple countries and cultures. Create a strong leadership pipeline and succession strategy. Foster an environment where individuals are empowered to perform at their best and grow their careers. Strengthen Customer Relationships Build trusted partnerships with healthcare providers, procurement stakeholders, key opinion leaders and strategic customers. Ensure customers experience the highest levels of service, support and partnership from Hologic. Represent Hologic as a passionate advocate for innovation and women's health. What We Expect You are a proven General Manager, Country Leader, Commercial Director or Business Unit Leader with experience leading businesses across multiple European markets. Significant leadership experience within Medical Devices, Healthcare Technology, Diagnostics or a related healthcare environment. Experience managing both direct sales organisations and distributor networks. Strong knowledge of healthcare systems, procurement processes and market dynamics across Europe. A track record of delivering sustainable growth, market share gains and commercial transformation. Experience working within capital equipment and recurring revenue business models. Success leading complex commercial negotiations, strategic partnerships and tender processes. Strong Business Acumen Full P&L leadership experience. Strong financial, commercial and operational expertise. Experience driving pricing optimisation, forecasting accuracy and margin improvement. A data-driven approach to decision making and performance management. Exceptional People Leadership The ability to lead diverse teams across multiple countries and cultures. Experience developing future leaders and building succession pipelines. A coaching leadership style that drives engagement and accountability. Confidence leading organisations through change and transformation. Influential Stakeholder Management Outstanding communication and presentation skills. Strong negotiation and influencing capabilities. The ability to build credibility quickly and foster long-term relationships. Experience navigating complex commercial and organisational challenges. Why Hologic? At Hologic, every role contributes to a bigger purpose. You'll join a company that combines innovation, scientific excellence and a deep commitment to improving women's health worldwide. This is more than a regional leadership role. It's an opportunity to shape the future of a strategically important business, lead meaningful transformation and make a lasting impact on healthcare outcomes across Europe. If you're a commercially driven leader with the vision, energy and ambition to transform a business and accelerate growth, we'd love to hear from you. Join Hologic and help redefine what's possible in Breast & Skeletal Health. Compensation: €120,000 – €185,000 gross pa base + commission (OTE €180,000 – €277,000 based on target performance, with opportunity to earn greater than OTE for those who exceed their targets). The final offer will depend on experience, skills, and alignment with internal pay structures. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including pension and insurances.

review_candidates.title: General Manager (Sur La Table)
review_candidates.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a General Manager at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing retail and culinary teams that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. This position combines strategic business acumen with strong operational expertise to drive both culinary and retail business performance while delivering #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail. Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and create development plans to support individual and team growth. Customer Experience & Brand Representation Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance Develop and implement strategies, including effective merchandising, marketing, and customer engagement, to exceed sales and financial goals across culinary and retail operations. Monitor and analyze key performance metrics daily to identify opportunities and optimize store performance. Consistently meet or exceed culinary and retail goals by delivering exceptional classes and customer experiences that drive engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail product sales, individual sales volume, average transaction value, customer conversion rates, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Operations & Compliance Oversee daily store operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and ensure proper product merchandising. Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. Maintains the accuracy and integrity of associates’ records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. Ability to remain standing for up to 5 hours at a time. Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. Workweeks are expected to be between 46 and 48 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. 3+ years of retail management experience, preferably in a specialty or culinary retail environment. Current Food Manager Certification, or ability to acquire certification as needed Proven track record of achieving sales and motivating high performing sales teams while meeting operational goals. Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, develop, and retain a high performing team. Excellent communication, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Passion for community engagement and providing exceptional customer experiences. review_candidates.title: General Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Diganto Express Contracting and Hospitality is an organization operating in the contracting and hospitality sectors in Doha. The company focuses on delivering reliable services and quality experiences to clients across its project and guest service portfolio. Team members collaborate closely to ensure operational efficiency, strong customer satisfaction, and compliance with local standards and regulations. The organization values accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement in both its contracting and hospitality operations. Role Description The General Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Doha. The individual in this role oversees daily operations across contracting and hospitality functions, ensuring that projects and services are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Responsibilities include managing departmental teams, setting performance targets, monitoring financial performance, and implementing policies and procedures for efficient operations. The General Manager works closely with stakeholders and clients, addresses operational issues, and leads initiatives to improve service delivery, safety, and customer experience. This role also involves strategic planning, resource allocation, and compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and company guidelines. Qualifications Proven experience in operations or general management, preferably within contracting, hospitality, or related service industries. Strong leadership and people management abilities, including performance management, team development, and cross-functional collaboration. Solid financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, cost control, and basic understanding of contracts and vendor management. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent the company to clients and partners. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the capacity to prioritize, make decisions, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Familiarity with local regulations, health and safety standards, and best practices in operational risk management. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Engineering, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage. Comfort with using standard business software and digital tools for reporting, scheduling, and coordination. Ability to work on-site in Doha and adapt to a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
